Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local

Class LanguagePreference

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.LanguagePreference
public final class LanguagePreference extends Object
Reads a weighted language preference list into the dialects to try, in the order to try them, as RFC 9110 describes.

Entries are separated by commas and may each carry a ;q= weight, which defaults to 1. An entry given zero weight is excluded, as is the * wildcard, which accepts anything and so is indistinguishable in effect from expressing no preference. Surviving entries are ordered by descending weight, with ties keeping the order they were written.

Nothing here raises an error: a value that cannot be read yields an empty list, which behaves as no preference. A lookup failing over a quirk in a header would be out of all proportion, and remote mode, which passes the header to the terminology server, would not fail either.

Author:
John Grimes
